Description: Runs the Claude Code CLI as the coding agent of a workflow; the API key reaches the agent container just-in-time.

Settings.Label: Anthropic API key
Settings.HelpText: Delivered to the agent container just-in-time and passed to the CLI only via its process environment; stored encrypted at rest and never displayed back.

Settings.Label: Model
Settings.HelpText: Optional model override (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6); the CLI's default model is used when empty.

Settings.Label: Maximum turns
Settings.HelpText: Hard cap on agent turns per run.

Settings.Label: CLI path
Settings.HelpText: Path of the Claude Code executable inside the workflow image; only changed for testing.
